name: Huf iOS app UI (native SwiftUI, iPhone 17 Pro)

source.reference: systems/huf-ios/ref/*.png + index.json (iPhone 17 Pro simulator, iOS 26.5, 3x, light + dark)

captureMode.how: Native apps cannot be DOM-captured, so components are hand-authored HTML/CSS (scripts/huf-mobile/ios/*.mjs) and rendered through the generic static spec source scripts/static-capture.mjs (scripts/specs-huf-ios.mjs). Output is identical to every other system.
captureMode.compare: node scripts/huf-mobile/compare-ref.mjs -> systems/huf-ios/ref-compare.json (perceptual diff vs the simulator PNGs)

tokens.fonts: SF Pro / SF Mono are not redistributable: Inter and Geist Mono (SIL OFL, tokens/fonts) are pinned for deterministic renders
tokens.icons: inline SVG (lucide-style strokes approximating SF Symbols)

rtl.mechanism: refs partly show Arabic (leaked app language); components are authored in English / LTR

states: default, active (pressed), loading, error, empty, disabled + named: filled, closed, html/diagram/source (see each states.json); hover/focus N/A (touch)

animation.ids: stable data-ui ids, boxes in measurements.json
